title: Product
description:
IGET SHION X1 Oral Nicotine Pouches
IGET SHION X1
Nicotine Pouches
is IGET’s first-ever nicotine pouch product. Place a pouch between your lip and gum to enjoy the nicotine and flavours released in your mouth. The compact and slim design is easy to carry, and more than 10 flavours are available for a great vaping experience. Try it now!
Package Content
IGET SHION X1 Nicotine Pouch (20 Slims)
Advantage
Lightweight design
10+ IGET SHION X1 Nicotine Pouch flavours
Spit-free: Discard the pouch when finished, and no need to spit
Smoke-free: No lingering cigarette odour and no staining of teeth
Easy to use: Park a discreet pouch between your lip and gum, and let the nicotine and flavour slowly release
Hands-free: You can enjoy the
IGET
SHION Nicotine Pouch while you’re on the go discreetly, which is more discreet than cigarettes or e-cigarettes
Frequently Asked Questions
How Long Will It Take for My Order to Arrive?
Delivery typically takes 2-5 business days. Please add an extra 2-3 days for remote areas. If you share your postal code, our support team can provide a more accurate delivery timeline for your address.
I Have Placed An Order, When Will The Package Be Shipped?
Orders are processed within 24 hours from Monday to Friday. Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number to locate your parcel.
Can I Change The Shipping Address Or Modify My Order Items?
If your item has not been sent out yet, you can still contact us to change your address. However, once your parcel has been shipped, you can redirect it on the tracking page. If you are unable to resolve this on your own, please feel free to
contact us
.
When Will An Out-of-stock Product Be Restocked?
Out-of-stock flavors are usually restocked within a week. Contact our support team with the flavors and quantity you are interested in, and we will assist you in reserving them in advance once they are restocked.
I Received A Faulty Vape Product, Do You Have A Warranty Policy?
We offer a 30-day warranty policy from the date of purchase. Please contact our customer service with details about the item and its problems. Any additional information such as pictures or videos would be helpful for us to provide an effective solution.
My Order Was Lost Or Something Is Missing.
Please contact our customer service with pictures of the parcel so that we can initiate an investigation and resolve the issue promptly. If it is confirmed that something is missing or lost, we will resend the items as soon as possible.
Is The Parcel Discreetly Packaged?
All our packaging is discreet to ensure your privacy.
